season.evidence: Mountaineers/Mazamas route listings give a broad Apr-Oct glacier window; SummitPost June-Nov; late July-August is the usual advice for a snow-free upper basin; our two logged Conrad Glacier ascents are Jul and Aug. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

Logged as the Warm Lake / Klickton ridge line, not the Conrad Glacier.
Logged as the Klickton divide line from Warm Lake; a snow ridge walk, not the Conrad Glacier.
Report describes Surprise Lake, the flat south of Warm Lake and the ridge: the southeast ridge line.

season.evidence: Mountaineers lists Apr-Oct, SummitPost Jun-Nov; reporters advise late July-August so the upper snowfield is gone (early July basin still all snow). Stored Jul-Sep kept.

season.evidence: SummitPost route page gives roughly Jun-Nov with crampons needed on frozen snow in early season; logged West Route ascents cluster Jul-Aug (Jun 1, Jul 3, Aug 1, Oct 1). Stored Jul-Sep kept.

track.why: Logged "W Route" from the Snowgrass trailhead (start 136 m from our pin), report describes the 7,200 ft saddle, the rib-by-rib goat-track traverse and the 7,600 ft saddle matching our Goat Ribs text; summited Jul 26 2025, round trip.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 15 2024, Snowgrass Trail 96 / Bypass 97 / west scramble, complete and summited; equally valid, 2919340 preferred as explicitly named W Route and newer.
Aug 31 West Route but start is 5 km from our pin (partial record), so not a complete track.
Turned back from Snowgrass in early July.

facts.text: Above the 7,200 ft saddle expect a faint goat track over at least four ribs, each a short drop and regain, until the ground eases near 7,600 ft.
From the 7,600 ft saddle the summit is farther than it looks, with two more class 3 steps still to climb.
Mid-July can leave a steep snowfield across the upper crux; one party downclimbed class 4 beside it and sidehilled over once low enough.

notes: Three listed routes only; the Conrad/Meade glacier routes have no matching track. The most-logged line from Conrad Meadows (via Surprise Lake, Warm Lake, then the southeast ridge / Klickton divide; tracks 2259534, 1950216, 3366743, 3353575, 3328439) is not in allRoutesOnPeak under any name; it looks like a missing standard route, class 2-3, roughly Jun-Oct.
